items.title: xdg-terminal-exec: 0.12.4 -> 0.13.0

items.content_html:
At work we have the use-case that several people connect to a large
Linux box to run tests and debug those interactively.

All tests write their state into a global /tmp -- e.g. the vde1 socket
and the VMs' state. This leads to conflicts when multiple people are
doing this.

This change uses ./.nixos-test-driver instead of /tmp outside of the
build sandbox, i.e. on interactive use to prevent this kind of conflict
in /tmp. This even allows having open interactive debug sessions for
VM tests in several project directories for a single user.

items.content_html:
Many flutter apps indirectly depend on xdg-user-dir being in PATH by using path_provider which in turn uses xdg_directories: https://github.com/flutter/packages/blob/a87eddf0c281d5d017093125c1a8d9161257741f/packages/xdg_directories/lib/xdg_directories.dart#L188

For example running Ente Auth Appimage from ente.io:

[ERROR:flutter/runtime/dart_vm_initializer.cc(41)] Unhandled Exception: MissingPlatformDirectoryException(Unable to get application documents directory)
#0 getApplicationDocumentsDirectory (package:path_provider/path_provider.dart:123)

items.content_html:
Ref: NixOS/nix#5588

This searches in $XDG_DATA_HOME/nix/profile everywhere where
previously we only looked in ~/.nix-profile, ditto for
.nix-channels and .nix-defexpr. This shouldn't break any
compatibility for now. It is highly recommended to use nixpkgs with
these changes if you want to use Nix with the XDG basedir PR, but not
doing so shouldn't result in any dramatic breakage -- in fact, NixOS
is perfectly usable without any user profile.
